## Summary

- What changed?
- Why was it needed?

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run format`
- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] Tested the change on the relevant platform(s)

## Checklist

- [ ] No unused files, components, or assets were added
- [ ] Config and environment changes are documented
- [ ] UI changes include screenshots or a short video when relevant
